station.name: Bourges
station.note: Official Météo-France fiche climatologique 18033001 (statistics 1991-2020), reproduced in an annex published by the Préfecture du Cher. Bourges is 43 km SW of the appellation (atlas near_city). The station inside the appellation (Bué 18039001, listed by Météo-France) and Sancerre 18241002 (closed 2014, partial data) had no reachable 1991-2020 fiche. Frost days not in the annex, so no Frost layer.
